_comment: The sales side: how a campaign reply is sorted, where the person moves, and the first draft of an answer. Change the words here; no code change needed. Drafts wait for a person until FCM_SEND_REPLIES=1. Stage names match Pinnacle Funding Group exactly. <NAME> values are read from the environment (set NAME at intake); an unset one refuses live writes.
_stage_renames: A stage's old name, read as its new one wherever GHL still shows it. Justin said yes on 2026-11-07 to renaming Facebook Leads' "MetaMuse Replied" to "Poster Replied" (the posters answer Facebook asks). The stage id doesn't change, so moves work before and after the rename in GHL's screen.

source.subject: Re: {subject}
source.body: Fair question{name}. Your name and work email came from a business contact provider. I'm a funding broker, and I write to owners who may want help with funding. If you'd rather not hear from me, say so and I'll stop.

map_rows.first: investor real estate financing, through a licensed partner.
a refinance or a consolidation. A partner has to look at what you owe first.
map_rows.skip: another advance on top of this one.

map_rows.first: equipment financing. The gear backs the deal, so you may be able to keep your cash for payroll and jobs.
map_rows.second: the vendor's own financing, as a number to compare.
map_rows.skip: paying it all in cash, if that would leave you short.

map_rows.first: invoice factoring, which turns what you're owed into cash now.
map_rows.second: a line of credit, which you can draw on and repay.

map_rows.first: getting your credit ready first, with a credit partner.

map_rows.second: 0% credit lines. Some owners may qualify after preparation. It takes good personal credit, and a partner decides.
map_rows.skip: term loans and SBA loans for now.

map_rows.first: a line of credit, which you can draw on and repay.
map_rows.second: a term loan, if this is a one-time need.
map_rows.skip: revenue-based funding, unless it's urgent. It's fast, and usually the most expensive.

map_rows.first: a term loan, a set amount paid back on a schedule.
map_rows.second: an SBA loan, if you can wait. It's often the longest term and the slowest.
